Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the IGSSupdateservice service, which listens on TCP port 12414 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose files in the context of SYSTEM. Schneider Electric has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
